notes: Twenty-five original EN/FR descriptions grounded in eight directly verified UNESCO World Heritage Centre heritage-property descriptions. Source verification is editorial, not owner art selection or museum-image approval. Historical site observations only; no claims of universal 1962 Roman Mass rubrics and no private R34 research promotion.

records.region_scope: Ravenna, Italy; site-specific heritage history, not a 1962 Roman Missal rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: Ravenna's UNESCO-listed early Christian complex contains eight buildings from the fifth and sixth centuries, when the city was a centre of Roman, Gothic and Byzantine power.
pilot_home_copy.fr: À Ravenne, l’ensemble paléochrétien inscrit à l’UNESCO réunit huit édifices des Ve et VIe siècles, lorsque la ville fut un centre des pouvoirs romain, goth et byzantin.

source.primary_locator: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Early Christian Monuments of Ravenna · Outstanding Universal Value · Brief synthesis

records.region_scope: Ravenna, Italy; site-specific heritage history, not a 1962 Roman Missal rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: The small Mausoleum of Galla Placidia in Ravenna holds lavish early Christian mosaics set against a deep blue background.
pilot_home_copy.fr: À Ravenne, le petit mausolée de Galla Placidia abrite de somptueuses mosaïques paléochrétiennes sur fond bleu profond.

source.primary_locator: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Early Christian Monuments of Ravenna · Outstanding Universal Value · Brief synthesis

records.region_scope: Ravenna, Italy; site-specific heritage history, not a 1962 Roman Missal rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: Ravenna's Neonian Baptistery is celebrated for its marble, stucco and multicoloured dome mosaics, surviving from the early Christian centuries.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Le baptistère des Orthodoxes, dit néonien, à Ravenne conserve des marbres, des stucs et des mosaïques polychromes dans sa coupole, hérités des premiers siècles chrétiens.

source.primary_locator: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Early Christian Monuments of Ravenna · Outstanding Universal Value · Brief synthesis

records.region_scope: Ravenna, Italy; site-specific heritage history, not a 1962 Roman Missal rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: Ravenna's Basilica of San Vitale, built in Justinian's era, blends architectural and artistic traditions of both East and West.
pilot_home_copy.fr: La basilique San Vitale de Ravenne, édifiée à l’époque de Justinien, associe des traditions architecturales et artistiques d’Orient et d’Occident.

source.primary_locator: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Early Christian Monuments of Ravenna · Outstanding Universal Value · Brief synthesis

records.region_scope: Chiloé Archipelago, Chile; site-specific heritage history, not a 1962 Roman Missal rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: Beginning in the seventeenth century, Jesuit missionaries made annual circuits among Chiloé's islands, while trained local laypeople cared for communities between visits.
pilot_home_copy.fr: À partir du XVIIe siècle, des jésuites parcouraient chaque année les îles de Chiloé ; entre leurs visites, des laïcs formés veillaient sur les communautés.

source.primary_locator: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Churches of Chiloé · Outstanding Universal Value · Brief synthesis

records.region_scope: Chiloé Archipelago, Chile; site-specific heritage history, not a 1962 Roman Missal rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: Sixteen timber churches of Chile's Chiloé archipelago are recognised by UNESCO as exceptional examples of a wider tradition of island mission churches.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Seize églises en bois de l’archipel chilien de Chiloé sont reconnues par l’UNESCO comme des témoins exceptionnels d’une tradition missionnaire insulaire plus vaste.

source.primary_locator: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Churches of Chiloé · Outstanding Universal Value · Brief synthesis

records.region_scope: Chiloé Archipelago, Chile; site-specific heritage history, not a 1962 Roman Missal rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: The wooden churches of Chiloé reflect local shipbuilding expertise: Chilote carpenters adapted boat-building forms and joints to towers and roofs.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Les églises en bois de Chiloé témoignent du savoir-faire naval local : les charpentiers ont adapté des formes et assemblages de bateaux aux tours et aux toitures.

source.primary_locator: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Churches of Chiloé · Outstanding Universal Value · Brief synthesis

records.region_scope: Chiloé Archipelago, Chile; site-specific heritage history, not a 1962 Roman Missal rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: Some Chiloé mission churches were deliberately raised on hills so sailors could see them and flooding would not reach them.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Certaines églises missionnaires de Chiloé furent délibérément établies sur des hauteurs, visibles des navigateurs et à l’abri des inondations.

source.primary_locator: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Churches of Chiloé · Outstanding Universal Value · Brief synthesis

records.heritage_property: Assisi, the Basilica of San Francesco and Other Franciscan Sites
records.region_scope: Assisi, Umbria, Italy; site-specific heritage history, not a 1962 Roman Missal rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: The Franciscan heritage area of Assisi includes the Carceri Hermitage, originally caves occupied by St Francis and his companions.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Le patrimoine franciscain d’Assise comprend l’ermitage des Carceri, à l’origine des grottes occupées par saint François et ses compagnons.

source.primary_locator: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Assisi, the Basilica of San Francesco and Other Franciscan Sites · Outstanding Universal Value · Brief synthesis

records.heritage_property: Assisi, the Basilica of San Francesco and Other Franciscan Sites
records.region_scope: Assisi, Umbria, Italy; site-specific heritage history, not a 1962 Roman Missal rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: Assisi's historic centre extends between the Basilica of St Francis at one end and the Basilica of St Clare at the other.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Le centre historique d’Assise s’étend entre la basilique Saint-François, à une extrémité, et la basilique Sainte-Claire, à l’autre.

source.primary_locator: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Assisi, the Basilica of San Francesco and Other Franciscan Sites · Outstanding Universal Value · Brief synthesis

records.heritage_property: Assisi, the Basilica of San Francesco and Other Franciscan Sites
records.region_scope: Assisi, Umbria, Italy; site-specific heritage history, not a 1962 Roman Missal rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: Assisi's UNESCO heritage landscape stretches beyond its walls to San Damiano, Rivotorto and the Basilica of Santa Maria degli Angeli on the plain.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Le paysage franciscain d’Assise inscrit à l’UNESCO dépasse les remparts et englobe San Damiano, Rivotorto et la basilique Sainte-Marie-des-Anges dans la plaine.

source.primary_locator: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Assisi, the Basilica of San Francesco and Other Franciscan Sites · Outstanding Universal Value · Brief synthesis

records.region_scope: Old Goa, India; site-specific heritage history, not a 1962 Roman Missal rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: The Basilica of Bom Jesus in Old Goa preserves the tomb of St Francis Xavier, whose missionary journeys reached India and Japan.
pilot_home_copy.fr: La basilique du Bon-Jésus à Vieux-Goa conserve le tombeau de saint François Xavier, dont les voyages missionnaires l’avaient conduit jusqu’en Inde et au Japon.

source.primary_locator: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Churches and Convents of Goa · Outstanding Universal Value · Brief synthesis

records.region_scope: Old Goa, India; site-specific heritage history, not a 1962 Roman Missal rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: Among Old Goa's surviving churches, Our Lady of the Rosary, dated 1549, is the earliest existing example there of Portuguese Manueline architecture.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Parmi les églises conservées de Vieux-Goa, Notre-Dame-du-Rosaire, datée de 1549, est le plus ancien exemple subsistant sur place de l’architecture manuéline portugaise.

source.primary_locator: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Churches and Convents of Goa · Outstanding Universal Value · Brief synthesis

records.region_scope: Old Goa, India; site-specific heritage history, not a 1962 Roman Missal rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: Old Goa's Church of St Cajetan, completed in 1661, was modelled on the original design of St Peter's Basilica in Rome.
pilot_home_copy.fr: À Vieux-Goa, l’église Saint-Gaétan, achevée en 1661, s’inspire du projet originel de la basilique Saint-Pierre de Rome.

source.primary_locator: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Churches and Convents of Goa · Outstanding Universal Value · Brief synthesis

records.region_scope: Wies, Bavaria, Germany; site-specific heritage history, not a 1962 Roman Missal rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: The pilgrimage to Wies grew from an account of tears seen in 1738 on a wooden image of the scourged Christ; UNESCO presents this as a reported miracle, not a verified physical finding.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Le pèlerinage de Wies naquit d’un récit de larmes observées en 1738 sur une statue en bois du Christ flagellé ; l’UNESCO présente cet épisode comme un miracle rapporté.

source.primary_locator: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Pilgrimage Church of Wies · Outstanding Universal Value · Brief synthesis

records.region_scope: Wies, Bavaria, Germany; site-specific heritage history, not a 1962 Roman Missal rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: Dominikus Zimmermann designed Bavaria's Wies pilgrimage church, built from 1745 to 1754, as an unusually luminous example of Rococo sacred architecture.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Dominikus Zimmermann conçut l’église de pèlerinage de Wies, en Bavière, construite de 1745 à 1754, comme un exemple particulièrement lumineux d’architecture sacrée rococo.

source.primary_locator: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Pilgrimage Church of Wies · Outstanding Universal Value · Brief synthesis

records.region_scope: Wies, Bavaria, Germany; site-specific heritage history, not a 1962 Roman Missal rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: In the Pilgrimage Church of Wies, the ceiling paintings use trompe-l'œil to suggest a sky opening above the worshippers.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Dans l’église de pèlerinage de Wies, les peintures du plafond utilisent le trompe-l’œil pour donner l’impression que le ciel s’ouvre au-dessus des fidèles.

source.primary_locator: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Pilgrimage Church of Wies · Outstanding Universal Value · Brief synthesis

records.heritage_property: Routes of Santiago de Compostela in France
records.region_scope: France and the Pyrenees; site-specific heritage history, not a 1962 Roman Missal rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: Four historic French approaches to Santiago de Compostela are traditionally associated with Paris, Vézelay, Le Puy and Arles before crossing the Pyrenees.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Quatre grandes voies françaises historiques vers Saint-Jacques-de-Compostelle sont associées à Paris, Vézelay, Le Puy et Arles avant le passage des Pyrénées.

source.primary_locator: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Routes of Santiago de Compostela in France · Outstanding Universal Value · Brief synthesis

records.heritage_property: Routes of Santiago de Compostela in France
records.region_scope: France and the Pyrenees; site-specific heritage history, not a 1962 Roman Missal rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: Along the medieval French roads to Santiago, pilgrim hospitals, bridges, roadside crosses and churches formed a network of both spiritual and practical support.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Le long des voies médiévales françaises vers Compostelle, hôpitaux de pèlerins, ponts, croix de chemin et églises assuraient un soutien à la fois spirituel et matériel.

source.primary_locator: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Routes of Santiago de Compostela in France · Outstanding Universal Value · Brief synthesis

records.heritage_property: Routes of Santiago de Compostela in France
records.region_scope: Pons, France; site-specific heritage history, not a 1962 Roman Missal rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: UNESCO's Santiago pilgrimage heritage in France includes the former pilgrims' hospital at Pons, showing how shelter was part of the medieval pilgrimage infrastructure.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Le patrimoine français des chemins de Compostelle inscrit à l’UNESCO comprend l’ancien hôpital des pèlerins de Pons, témoin de l’importance de l’accueil dans les pèlerinages médiévaux.

source.primary_locator: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Routes of Santiago de Compostela in France · Outstanding Universal Value · Brief synthesis

records.heritage_property: Sanctuary of Bom Jesus do Congonhas
records.region_scope: Congonhas, Minas Gerais, Brazil; site-specific heritage history, not a 1962 Roman Missal rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: The churchyard stairway at Brazil's Bom Jesus sanctuary in Congonhas is lined with twelve soapstone prophets sculpted by Aleijadinho.
pilot_home_copy.fr: L’escalier du sanctuaire du Bon-Jésus à Congonhas, au Brésil, est bordé de douze prophètes en stéatite sculptés par Aleijadinho.

source.primary_locator: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Sanctuary of Bom Jesus do Congonhas · Outstanding Universal Value · Brief synthesis

records.heritage_property: Sanctuary of Bom Jesus do Congonhas
records.region_scope: Congonhas, Minas Gerais, Brazil; site-specific heritage history, not a 1962 Roman Missal rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: At Congonhas, six chapels on the approach to the sanctuary hold sculpted episodes from Christ's Passion, a Brazilian expression of the Stations of the Cross.
pilot_home_copy.fr: À Congonhas, six chapelles sur le chemin du sanctuaire abritent des épisodes sculptés de la Passion du Christ, expression brésilienne du chemin de croix.

source.primary_locator: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Sanctuary of Bom Jesus do Congonhas · Outstanding Universal Value · Brief synthesis

records.heritage_property: Sanctuary of Bom Jesus do Congonhas
records.region_scope: Congonhas, Minas Gerais, Brazil; site-specific heritage history, not a 1962 Roman Missal rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: Aleijadinho's polychrome wooden Passion figures at Congonhas combine sculpture and religious storytelling in an eighteenth-century Brazilian Baroque sanctuary.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Les figures en bois polychrome de la Passion réalisées par Aleijadinho à Congonhas mêlent sculpture et récit religieux dans un sanctuaire baroque brésilien du XVIIIe siècle.

source.primary_locator: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Sanctuary of Bom Jesus do Congonhas · Outstanding Universal Value · Brief synthesis

records.region_scope: Misiones, Argentina and Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil; site-specific heritage history, not a 1962 Roman Missal rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: UNESCO's Jesuit-Guarani heritage includes four mission sites in Argentina and one at São Miguel in Brazil, surviving from the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Le patrimoine jésuite-guarani reconnu par l’UNESCO comprend quatre missions en Argentine et celle de São Miguel au Brésil, héritées des XVIIe et XVIIIe siècles.

source.primary_locator: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Jesuit Missions of the Guaranis · Outstanding Universal Value · Brief synthesis

records.region_scope: Misiones, Argentina and Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil; site-specific heritage history, not a 1962 Roman Missal rubric

pilot_home_copy.en: The historic Jesuit-Guarani reducciones linked a church with residences, workshops, agricultural plots and a central square, shaping both worship and everyday community life.
pilot_home_copy.fr: Les anciennes réductions jésuites-guaranies associaient église, habitations, ateliers, cultures et place centrale, organisant ensemble la prière et la vie quotidienne.

source.primary_locator: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Jesuit Missions of the Guaranis · Outstanding Universal Value · Brief synthesis
